title: My TOP 3 Calisthenics Chest Exercises (Exotic Push-Ups For Muscle Growth)
summary: NH shares his three favorite push-up variations: diamond (and deficit diamond) push-ups, ring push-ups including a fly version, and sphinx push-ups. He builds his chest with a mix of bench press and push-ups, using push-ups after pressing to take advantage of pre-fatigue, and uses push-up performance to check that bench gains aren't just fat gain.
claims: NH builds his chest with a mix of bench press and push-ups; bodyweight or weighted push-ups alone are not enough stimulus for him
Push-ups are not just for novices; advanced lifters with a lot of muscle still benefit from them
Diamond push-ups shift work toward the triceps with a longer range of motion; add 2-3 sets to failure at the end of a workout for lifters whose triceps lag despite bench and dips
Doing push-ups after bench press or dips means you are pre-fatigued, which artificially raises the intensity of the push-ups so they are not wasted volume
Deficit diamond push-ups increase range of motion, are harder on the triceps and give NH just the right amount of shoulder work
In diamond push-ups, hands placed closer to the abs recruit more chest; hands placed closer to the head recruit more arms
Ring push-ups remove the drawbacks of regular push-ups: no wrist pain and no floor limiting depth, so you can go as deep as you want
Calisthenics movements are meant to be done with high frequency and volume, which works because ring push-ups are fun and easy to recover from
On ring push-ups, squeeze the chest at the top for the mind-muscle connection, and go into a deep but safe stretch at the bottom if shoulder mobility allows
Because of his leverages NH doesn't get full pec range of motion on the bench, so he gets the deep stretch from ring push-ups
Ring fly push-ups: start with a neutral grip, let the chest expand at the bottom, rotate back as you press; begin with elbows tucked and widen as you get stronger
Many pec tears happen because people only train a limited range, so the muscle is unused to deep positions; bodyweight ring work through a deeper stretch with a controlled negative helps prevent this
The best mix is a heavy horizontal press followed by ring push-ups
Sphinx push-ups (pushing up from the elbows onto the hands) remove shoulder flexion and work the triceps nearly in isolation with bodyweight
Start plank sets with sphinx push-ups to failure, then hold the plank; pre-fatiguing the core makes planks more intense and less boring
Aim to build up to 20 strict sphinx push-ups in a row, which carries over to planks and abs work; go carefully at first because they demand heavy shoulder stabilization
In sphinx push-ups, hands farther forward make stabilization harder, while hands under the jaw lengthen the triceps range of motion
If your bench goes up while your push-ups go down, you may be gaining strength from added fat; keep push-ups in your training to stay balanced
